content: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) devices are recommended for individuals who are managing their diabetes with intensive insulin therapy. This includes those who are administering multiple daily injections of insulin (MDI) or utilizing continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) systems. The American Diabetes Association (ADA) specifically endorses the use of either real-time CGM (rtCGM) or intermittently scanned CGM (isCGM) for these patients.
